attributes.title: 2027 NMCA Annual Counseling Conference: Counseling with Confidence
attributes.series: New Mexico Counseling Association Annual Counseling Conference
attributes.summary:
The New Mexico Counseling Association's 2027 Annual Counseling Conference, themed "Counseling with Confidence: Guiding Growth in the Southwest", takes place March 12 and 13, 2027, at the Clyde Hotel in Albuquerque.

NMCA lists the continuing education as approved by NBCC. The conference page says attendees can earn up to 16 CE credits, with 3 more from a free virtual pre-conference, though one line on the page shows a garbled total, so confirm the final count with NMCA.

Registration runs through February 15, 2027, or until the event sells out. The page lists two inconsistent early-bird price sets, so we have not reproduced fees here; check the registration page for current prices.
